question: TQ-035 requires a CWP to be released only when its EWP is complete (all documents IFC). With the Rev B MDL a piping CWP carries up to 2,800 isometric sheets and a civil CWP the reinforcement of every pour; requiring all of them IFC before the first IWP would delay construction by 3-9 months or require engineering staff far above a realistic peak. The consortium proposes: (a) a CWP is released when the documents of its first IWPs are IFC (layouts, GA, foundations, plans: 100 % at release) and its materials for those IWPs are on site or confirmed; (b) progressive documents (isometrics, supports, schematics, loop diagrams, reinforcement, equipment foundations) are released per IWP, planned at CWP start - lead + share x CWP duration per document type; (c) no IWP is issued to the field unless all its documents are IFC and its constraints removed; (d) the EWP completeness per CWP is reported monthly.
response: Accepted as proposed, with the condition that the monthly report shows per CWP the IFC status of the documents needed for the next 8 weeks of IWPs, and that a CWP whose first-IWP documents are not IFC is not started. TQ-035 item (4) is amended accordingly.
subject: AWP release rule: progressive EWP release to the IWPs of a CWP
